```{r}
library(arrow)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
df = read_parquet("T:/lab_research/RES-Folder-UPOD/ODIN-UC4/E_ResearchData/2_ResearchData/20240805/lab_pivoted_aggregated.parquet")
```

```{r}
c_names <- colnames(df)
new_names <- list()
for (i in c_names){
  new_names <- append(new_names,gsub("[\\s\\(\\)]", "", i))
}

print(new_names)

```

```{r}
names(df) <- new_names
print(df)
```

```{r}
library(mice)

```

```{r}
imputed_data <- mice(df,method = "pmm",seed = 42)

# Extract the first imputed data set
completed_data <- complete(imputed_data, 1)

# View the completed data frame
print(completed_data)
```

```{r}
densityplot(imputed_data)
```
